title: D-6 orphan reaper path results

contract.reapRetired: reapRetired(roots: UserLayerRoots, retired: SkillsShRetiredRegistry | null): Promise<ReapResult>; shares sweep() with reap().
contract.results: ReapResult.reapedPaths (ReapClonePath & {removedPaths}), keptPaths (ReapClonePath & {reason: diverged|edited|unhashable|symlink}), failedPaths (ReapClonePath & {error}); ReapClonePath = {kind, slug, path, sourceRef}.
contract.ledger: Key = path; item id = sourceRef (skillsShRetiredItemId(rootId)); skip null sourceRef. A failed path that no longer exists (lstat ENOENT) counts as removed.
contract.safety: Delete only non-diverged clones whose live hash equals sourceHash, with no links, full-depth walk; snapshot to .history first; fs.removePath refuses outside ~/.ptah/user and under ~/.ptah/plugins.

handoffBatch33: UserLayerOrphanReaper and the new row types are not exported from the agent-generation barrel; Batch 33 adds that export (or a UserLayerMirrorService.reapRetiredClones method).
